The purpose of this practice emphasizes the use of water instead of ink, as traditional ink would be unsuitable for the practice format. Instead, learning tools include soft absorbent paper and a brush dipped in water, enabling students to simulate written characters adeptly.  The image further illustrates a calligraphy practice book designed explicitly for brush calligraphy, negating the need for traditional ink and paper. It features clear instructions alongside a row of characters that reinforce the message, "No paper, no ink, brush pen calligraphy practice book."
